harmonicFunction: Em (i) - Tonic minor chord establishing dark, raw acoustic foundation
G (bIII) - Relative major chord providing instant melodic lift and pop sensibility
C#m (vi) - Unexpected chromatic minor shift in the chorus creating sharp grunge tension
C - D (bVI - bVII) - Classic rock double-plagal turnaround leading triumphantly back to Em

techniques.name: Crisp Dynamic Acoustic Grunge Strum
techniques.description: Driving 4/4 down-up acoustic rhythm played with energetic wrist action, emphasizing low bass notes on beat 1 and open treble strings on upstrokes

sequence: Tune all six strings down one half-step (Eb Ab Db Gb Bb Eb)
Strum open Em with a heavy downstroke on beat 1
Transition quickly to open G on beat 3
tips: Keep the right hand moving in a steady pendulum even when muting
During the chorus barre chords (C#m, G#, F#), keep your index finger barred firmly
Let the high open strings ring during the C to D resolution
details.progression: Em - G (Verse) / C#m - G# - F# - A - C - D (Chorus)

techniques.name: Chromatic Barre Shifts & Melodic Pentatonic Soloing
techniques.description: Executing the chromatic barre chord progression of the chorus (C#m - G# - F#) with full fret-hand barring, transitioning into Kurt Cobain's melodic open-position E minor pentatonic solo

notes: Solo notes: Open G, 2nd fret G (A), open B, 3rd fret B (D), open high E, 3rd fret high E (G)
sequence: Lock into the downstroke-driven chorus barre shifts: C#m to G# to F#
Resolve through open A to C and D before cycling back to Em
During the solo, use alternating down-up picking across strings 3, 2, and 1
Emphasize the wide open-string pulls and natural dissonance
tips: Keep thumb positioned behind the neck on barre chords for clean leverage
Do not over-bend in the solo—Kurt's playing is melodic, vocal, and understated
Let the open treble strings chime naturally during the transition out of the solo
details.progression: C#m - G# - F# - A - C - D

sections.name: Intro
sections.description: Kurt Cobain kicks off the legendary MTV Unplugged performance with his trademark open Em to G acoustic strum.
notes: Half-Step Down tuning (Eb Ab Db Gb Bb Eb)
Punchy acoustic down-up strumming at 130 BPM
Accented bass notes on beats 1 and 3

sections.name: Verse
sections.description: Melodic storytelling verse with steady, energetic acoustic strumming supporting Cobain's vocal line.
sections.progression: Em - G - Em - G - Em - G - Em - G
notes: Sing along: 'I need an easy friend, I do, with an ear to lend...'
Smooth finger transitions between Em and G

sections.name: Chorus
sections.description: The chorus steps out into dramatic barre chords before resolving through C and D back to Em.
sections.progression: C#m - G# - F# - A - C - D
notes: Fret the C#m and G# barre chords cleanly
Open chord power on A, C, and D
Drive into the next verse with full energy

notes: Follow the melodic bends and open string pulls in Cobain's solo
Practice alternate picking on upper strings

beginner.title: Master the Em - G Verse Strum
steps: Tune guitar down one half-step to Eb Ab Db Gb Bb Eb
Practice changing cleanly between open Em and G
Lock into the 130 BPM eighth-note strumming pattern
Sing along with the verse lyrics

intermediate.title: Nail the Chorus Barre Chords
steps: Learn the C#m and G# barre chord shapes
Practice the rapid shift from F# to open A, C, and D
Perform the full song structure at 130 BPM

advanced.title: Master the Acoustic Solo & Performance
steps: Learn Kurt Cobain's melodic pentatonic solo
Capture the raw, vulnerable vocal intensity of MTV Unplugged
Perform the complete unplugged classic live

commonMistakes: Playing in standard tuning — the MTV Unplugged version is tuned down one half-step
Rushing past 130 BPM — keep the groove bouncy and measured
Muting strings during the chorus barre chords
practiceRoutine: 5 minutes: Em to G transition drill at 130 BPM
5 minutes: Chorus barre chord shifts (C#m → G# → F#)
metronomeWork: Practice at 110 BPM while memorizing chorus chord changes
Advance to target 130 BPM for the authentic MTV Unplugged energy
Set metronome on beats 2 and 4 to lock in the drum backbeat
